question: Estimate the EV battery manufacturing market opportunity in India by 2030.
idealClarificationQuestions: Battery cell + pack manufacturing revenue in India? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: India 2030 battery manufacturing capacity target: ~150 GWh annual (PLI scheme + private investments).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual revenue at production: 120 GWh × ₹65L/kWh = ~₹78,000 Cr (~$9.5B).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total: ~₹90,000 Cr (~$11B) Indian battery manufacturing market by 2030.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus battery pack assembly + thermal management + BMS systems

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~₹90,000 Cr (~$11B) Indian battery manufacturing market by 2030.

calculationFlow: India 2030 battery manufacturing capacity target: ~150 GWh annual (PLI scheme + private investments).
Annual revenue at production: 120 GWh × ₹65L/kWh = ~₹78,000 Cr (~$9.5B).
Plus battery pack assembly + thermal management + BMS systems: ~₹15,000 Cr.
Total: ~₹90,000 Cr (~$11B) Indian battery manufacturing market by 2030.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total: ~₹90,000 Cr (~$11B) Indian battery manufacturing market by 2030.
